title: Load-safe exchange: short captured supports, removable contacts and local comparison
status_authority: Whole unchanged supplied sources at their exact contracts; no new Capital execution, physical validation or independent audit.
reported_status: P1 constructs a materially different ground-mounted cradle: short opposing contacts capture movement, original bearing contacts leave without translating the member, pod-owned cages capture severed heads, and independent member/foot necks permit jam escape. Large final withdrawal supports a complete-profile absence test. The coupled model completes500 conditional sequences, but uncorrected target deformation gives a1.0254mm strut catch bound, the full-stock jam moment screen reaches3.548kNm against3.5kNm, and real tool routes remain incomplete. Human work improves7.69-fold rather than tenfold; an automated adopter reaches cost parity. ROOT separately supplies local-comparison, finite applied-wrench and restoration contracts without qualifying those missing operations. Earlier scoped results remain unchanged; qualified physical exchanges remain0.
